newsitem.title: USA: US Dec S&Ps ends near 730.00 on late strong rally.
newsitem.headline: US Dec S&Ps ends near 730.00 on late strong rally.

text.p: U.S. December Standard & Poor's (S&P) 500 futures ended in record-high territory after the contract rallied almost nine points in the last hour of pit trade, traders and analysts said.
At 1400 CST/2000 GMT, December S&Ps were trading around 720.90.
An hour later, the contract had risen nearly nine points to an all-time high of 729.80.
Some analysts expect December to climb to 730.00, about a two percent rise from Tuesday's settlement price, by the end of next week.
